output_definition.rows: Every distinct cited work; no claim-based exclusion
output_definition.order: First citation occurrence in the complete bullet after established identity deduplication
output_definition.ties: Retain all distinct works, including equal claims

query_categories.SAMPLE_FUNCTION: Declared sampled-loss model with same-sample finite differences
query_categories.EXACT_FUNCTION: Fixed-function values; random directions do not imply sampled-loss noise

gap_categories.EXPECTED_UNIFORM_GAP: Expectation of the paper's gap at a uniformly selected iterate in ITERATES
gap_categories.EXPECTED_MIN_GAP: Expectation outside the minimum over the paper's gaps in ITERATES

output_definition.iterate_range: Inclusive endpoints in the source iterate variable; preserve the gap-to-iterate index shift
output_definition.missing: UNKNOWN in unresolved non-key cells; retain row; unresolved identities use CITE_n without inferred merging
